players.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
players.note: Antetokounmpo is probable for Friday's game against the Knicks due to right groin tendinitis.

players.name: Andrew Wiggins
players.note: Wiggins is probable for Friday's game against the Knicks due to a right ankle sprain.

players.name: Miles McBride
players.note: McBride (adductor) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

players.name: Cade Cunningham
players.note: Cunningham (knee) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

players.name: Aaron Nesmith
players.note: Nesmith is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to right foot soreness.

players.name: Jaylen Brown
players.note: Brown (hamstring) will receive imaging, and the Sixers will provide an update Thursday, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

players.name: Joel Embiid
players.note: Embiid (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against Miami, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Alijah Martin
players.note: Martin is questionable for Friday's game against the Nets due to left knee soreness.

players.name: Zach Edey
players.note: Edey (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 115-97 win over the Clippers. He finished with seven points (3-4 FG, 1-1 FT), four rebounds, two assists and two blocks across nine minutes.

players.name: LaMelo Ball
players.note: Ball (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 113-106 win over the Thunder.

players.name: De'Aaron Fox
players.note: Fox (shin) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

players.name: Jaxson Hayes
players.note: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

players.name: Julian Reese
players.note: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.
